# Fear & Greed – Tradingprofilen: “Flockdjuret har blivit vildare"

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-11-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Host Semir Hassambegovic interviews ex-broker and private trader Oskar Ekman. Ekman reads the recent AI-driven sell-off, with CNN's Fear & Greed index near 10–17, as a contrarian buy signal. He thinks a bottom was likely set the previous Friday, that the AI-bubble story has gone stale as news, and that the run into year-end and January is seasonally strong. He leans long beaten-down small caps and property stocks, buys large caps on dips (Sandvik, Boliden, Volvo, banks), and stresses scaling in and out, selling discipline and herd psychology.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Down from 400 to about 320. Guest bought some and puts it in the 100k money-bag for 2027.

#### Reasoning

Guest's (Oskar Ekman) view: the AI panic has dragged down all valuations, including quality industrials. A sharp fall in a large, safe company is a reason to add some exposure. He recommends scaling in rather than going all in at once.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI-driven risk-off deepens beyond the presumed bottom
- if the January 2027 outlook turns weak

> *"jag köpte faktiskt lite Sandvik häromdagen"*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest owns it and thinks retail buying is right. Sees a bottom set Friday but expects more volatility.

#### Reasoning

Guest's view: the AI-bubble story has gone stale as news, Fear & Greed below 10 is a contrarian buy, and Nvidia is a world leader in the hottest field. He expects choppy, high-volatility trading for a while.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Friday's low is broken
- if the AI-overvaluation story regains momentum

> *"Jag äger den själv nu och har gjort en stund"*

---

### 🟢 BOL — Boliden | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Bought after a 6% drop on copper-price headlines.

#### Reasoning

Guest buys large caps on outsized moves driven by outside news (copper headlines) rather than company-specific information.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the copper price keeps falling
- if company-specific negative news emerges

> *"Jag köpte Boliden häromdagen när det började."*

---

### 🟠 VOLV-B — Volvo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A large-cap dividend name for the money-bag. 'Felt a bit interesting' and he is watching it.

#### Reasoning

Guest suggests filling the long-term allocation with large caps that pay good dividends, like Sandvik, Volvo and banks. He calls them boring but comfortable to own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the broad market bottom fails

> *"Volvo tycker jag kanske kändes lite intressant häromdagen"*

---

### 🟢 FABG — Fabege | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest is overweight property stocks and trades Fabege a lot. Thinks the sector has been treated harshly.

#### Reasoning

Property stocks have been weak for years, so the downside feels limited, and a sector catalyst could give 10-20%. He finds it reasonable to own some property stocks now despite higher rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates rise further

> *"Jag handlar mycket i Fabege, men egentligen så går det att äga de flesta."*

---

### 🟠 DOM — Dometic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Example of a beaten-down mid cap moving strongly. Guest favours the smaller half of the exchange for December and January.

#### Reasoning

Guest's view: seasonally strong winter months, small caps oversold after the AI panic, and small-cap trading gets sharper over Christmas. His advice is to look at the price chart first.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the year-end small-cap seasonality fails

> *"Bland annat Dometic och de här som är halvstora bolag"*

---

### 🟠 SEYE — Smart Eye | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Zero interest, about 1% spread. Guest sees the neglect as a positive contrarian sign.

#### Reasoning

Guest has followed it since the IPO. Total lack of interest (one X hit on report day) is, in his view, a lovely sign of capitulation in small caps.

#### Sell Triggers

- if short positions keep building

> *"intresset i de här bolagen, det är noll just nu och det är ett jättehärligt tecken tycker jag"*

---

### 🔴 ABB — ABB | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest has been short ABB for a while. He says his short trades are always very brief.

#### Reasoning

A short-term tactical short only. The guest says he would never recommend shorting to others and cannot stay short for long.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market rebounds broadly

> *"Vi har ju varit korta ABB en stund."*

---

### ⛔ MEKO — Mekonomen | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest admits being wrong buying after a weak report and calls it his 'Golgatha'.

#### Reasoning

He assumed a 50% fall was already priced in, but he had not followed the company. The report was worse than he thought and the stock kept falling.

#### Sell Triggers

- if fundamentals stabilise in the next report

> *"Mekonomen är ju mitt Golgata just nu."*

---

### 🟡 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Core trading name: adds on dips and sells on rallies.

#### Reasoning

Guest trades around a core position, scaling in and out based on his read of price swings.

> *"Jag handlar Electrolux, det tycker jag är kul."*

---

### 🟡 ALIV-SDB — Autoliv | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

In the guest's long-term portfolio since the start.

#### Reasoning

One of the few names held steadily in his otherwise actively traded long portfolio.

> *"Nu har vi väl kanske Autoliv legat där från start"*
